A true gastronomic gem in Nha Trang!
Aug 2026 • Family
We loved everything. The restaurant has an incredibly pleasant and relaxing atmosphere, it is very cozy inside, perfectly clean, and there is wonderful music playing in the background that does not interfere with conversation at all. Special thanks to the staff - the guys are very attentive, warning, and sincerely hospitable.
Food is just pure delight! Every dish was excellent:
 Hand-sliced jamón is perfect, with a rich flavor, it literally melts in your mouth.
 Pan Con Tomato (tomato bread) - crispy, with light notes of garlic and the freshest grated tomatoes. Amazingly bright taste!
 Grilled fish fillet is cooked perfectly. The fish turned out tender, juicy, and very fragrant.
 Marinated olives are the right, large Spanish olives that have become a perfect addition to our table.
A wonderful place for a delicious and heartfelt family dinner. Definitely recommend visiting!

A genuine taste of Spain in Nha Trang
Aug 2026 • Family
If you are looking for authentic Spanish food, Lola Taperia is easily the best and only real option in town. It genuinely feels like a small piece of Spain right here in Vietnam. The Kitchen: The head chef is Catalan, and it shows in the quality. They serve authentic Jamón Ibérico, four distinct types of well-made paella, and a great selection of traditional tapas. The Wine: The menu features excellent Rioja wines that pair perfectly with the food. The Vibe: The restaurant has a relaxed, authentic atmosphere without being overly commercial.
Read more
Insider tip:
If you want a proper European dining experience for an evening, this place is highly recommended.

Highly recommended!
May 2026 • Couples
We stumbled upon this Spanish taperia by chance while walking back from a massage and decided to pop in—and what a fantastic decision that was!

Every single tapa we tried was absolutely delicious, but a few things truly stood out:

The Tomato Jam: This was a surprise. We found out they make the tomato jam fresh daily, and to our absolute regret, they don't sell it by the jar—otherwise, we would have taken some home!

Vinegar Herring Tapa: The fish was incredibly fresh, and the flavors were perfectly balanced.

If you are looking for authentic, high-quality tapas, this place is a must-visit.

Friendly, attentive staff and authentic Spanish cuisine
Apr 2026 • Family
If you are looking for a place to enjoy authentic Spanish cuisine in Vietnam then this restaurant is for you. Dishes can seem a bit small but very delicious. Having tasted the same dishes in Spain, we can reassure you that they are as great. Moreover, the waiters are so attentive that your table will always have place for more plates to come and stay clean throughout the whole meal. Staff is also friendly since they speak English fluently and can help you with anything or recommend places of interest. Afterwards they gave us a card that gives 10% discount in other restaurants of their chain. Overall, we left with an aftertaste of having spent an evening in a great place with tasty food,
